messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Is the UR5e robot arm able to be commissioned and operated by itself, straight from the manufacturer, without anything else being added?

response.text: Il braccio robotico UR5e può essere messo in servizio e utilizzato da solo, direttamente dal produttore, senza aggiungere nulla?
